mapper.sql: r.id, r.term, r.batch_ids, r.building, r.room_no, r.member_count, r.avg_score, r.min_score, r.rank_in_building, r.awarded, r.award_level, r.published_at, r.created_at, r.updated_at, r.deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_civil_room (term, batch_ids, building, room_no, member_count, avg_score, min_score, rank_in_building, awarded, award_level, published_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{term}, #{batchIds}, #{building}, #{roomNo}, #{memberCount}, #{avgScore}, #{minScore}, #{rankInBuilding}, #{awarded}, #{awardLevel}, #{publishedAt}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE community_civil_room SET batch_ids = #{batchIds}, member_count = #{memberCount}, avg_score = #{avgScore}, min_score = #{minScore}, rank_in_building = #{rankInBuilding}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND published_at IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT FROM community_civil_room r WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.deleted = 0
SELECT FROM community_civil_room r WHERE r.term = #{term} AND r.building = #{building} AND r.room_no = #{roomNo} AND r.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE community_civil_room SET deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE term = #{term} AND deleted = 0 AND published_at IS NULL
UPDATE community_civil_room SET awarded = #{awarded}, award_level = #{awardLevel}, published_at = #{publishedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND published_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT i.building AS building, i.room_no AS room_no, COUNT(*) AS member_count, ROUND(AVG(i.score), 2) AS avg_score, MIN(i.score) AS min_score, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT i.batch_id ORDER BY i.batch_id) AS batch_ids FROM community_inspection i INNER JOIN community_batch b ON b.id = i.batch_id AND b.deleted = 0 WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND b.term = #{term} AND b.status IN #{st} GROUP BY i.building, i.room_no ORDER BY i.building ASC, avg_score DESC, i.room_no ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN r.published_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS published, SUM(CASE WHEN r.awarded = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS awarded, ROUND(MAX(r.avg_score), 2) AS best_avg, COUNT(DISTINCT r.building) AS buildings FROM community_civil_room r WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND r.term = #{term}
